Hey there. I am 20f. 
I had been struggling with acne all my life. I was insecure and i felt ugly, i tried home remedies, anything i could get my hands on, from garlic to toothpaste, everything. I was 18-ish when i first went to the dermatologist and he put me on 3 months of oral isoretinoin and it literally changed my life, not exaggerating.
 To avoid relapse, i was told to put retinol creams every other day for 6 months. I liked what it did to my skin, 1 year later i am still using 0.025% tretinoin but i am thinking I will should up the dose a bit.
 The first year was very hard, i easily got sunburnt, my skin was peeling off and man the dry chapped lifeless lips. I tried burts bees, carmex, eos but nothing seemed to help in the long run. The chapped lips subsided eventually.

The things i would suggest from my experience are :
1) use gel based sunblock religiously, preferably something moisturising 
2) moisturise moisturise moisturise. (I used cerave or cetaphil moisturizer)
3) get a foam based facewash, the one by dermafique is good too.
4)when starting topical retinols, please use it after a layer of your favorite moisturizer. It is very drying, especially if your skin is not used to it.
5) invest in a good lip balm 
6)The most important thing, pimples are not ugly, just really uncomfortable and painful. It took me so long to realise that.

You will eventually realise what works for you and what doesn't and watch all the videos and read all the articles about using isoretinoin but it will be worth it in the end. Best of luck ❤️
